function.description: Close every open prediction position for the wallet in one call — each position gets its own independent sell-or-claim (whichever applies) and its own broadcast result; a failure on one position never blocks or rolls back the others. Zero open positions is reported as an explicit success with zero rows, never an error. Every result is truthful-pending — this never confirms any position in this call. Use solana.predict.sell/.claim instead to close just ONE position.
function.name: solana__predict__closeAll

minSellPriceSlippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance applied to EACH sell in this batch, in basis points (0-1000; e.g. 100 = 1%). Vex caps slippage at 1000 bps (10%) and rejects anything above rather than clamping. Required by the provider — there is no default, so pick a value you accept across every position closed.
